_comment: Network service endpoints (portable containers). Full URLs only — never container names — so services can move to any docker host by editing this file. Pattern: db_config.json for DBs, services.json for tool services.

openscad.notes: Headless OpenSCAD render service. POST /render, GET /healthz, GET /templates. Source: services/openscad/

whisper.notes: Not yet containerized — transcription still via whisper_nfs_worker.pl on workstation.

search.notes: Self-hosted SearXNG metasearch. DISABLED until the container is running (cd services/search && docker compose up -d --build). Enabled=0 means no network traffic. Why self-hosted: OpenRouter's search_domain_filter is silently ignored, so scope control needs a service we run. Source: services/search/

ollama.notes: Existing service; listed here for the full services map. AI code may still use its own config.
